meta.about: Words the Friuli content uses that Wiktionary lacks (companion/bin/lexicon-build --coverage --lang it lists them): the folklore of Nonno Bepi's stories (sbilfs, krivapete, the Orcolat), Friulian words (fogolâr, pignarûl, cramaro), the region's places as the content names them (the Collio, Cormòns, Carnia, Monte Lussari, Duino, Nova Gorica), the night sky's meteor showers, an imperative with its pronoun joined (arrotolala), the elided c'è, dov'è, cos'è (Wiktionary has them in English only, or as a junk infinitive), and, marked override, a better meaning for suo, whose German through English was sein; n. Each has its meaning in German and Slovene (meanings), so a learner from either reads it in their own language, flagged machine-written. Left out: the people's names (the villagers' come from the cast), the interjections and sounds but eh, the most frequent (hm, shh, bzz), and the wrong choices the dialogs offer on purpose (venirò, vedito). Since 2026-11-01 also the words the course's printed sheets left off for want of a meaning (the everyday verbs, adverbs, nouns and expressions of A1, A2 and B1: guardare, mai, il treno, c'era una volta), written for a child (German first, Slovene, English), each with the forms the Italian content uses (the course, the grammar book, the Friuli culture, the packs) and their grammar; a reflexive verb's forms with their pronoun (si lava, mi sono lavata), so the plain verb's (gira il frico) aren't taken for it; the forms written by hand and checked against Wiktionary's (kaikki.org, English and German Wiktionary), the meanings written, not copied (docs/plans/05-built/it-print-meanings.md). Since stories-friuli (2026-11): the folklore, places and Friulian words of Nonno Bepi's new tales and readings (the malandanti, the cjarsons and the crassigne, the Rölar and the Kheirar of Sauris, Tarcento's Pignarûl Grant and its saying fum, soreli, cjape il sac, the Tagliamento, Aquileia, Svete Višarje), the countries and towns they name, three numbers, and the grammar words a child meets on every line, so a tap explains them in German and Slovene too: avere's present (ha), the prepositions with an article (della, nel, sulla, alle, dal), dimmi and dammi, tanto, troppo, un po', and a few verbs with their pronoun joined or as a participle. Since 2026-11-02 (supplement-it) also every other word of the Italian content a tap met nothing for, so that a tap means the word on a phone without Wiktionary: the function words (il, la, un, che, non, per, si), the articles and contractions, the clitics, the verbs and the forms the content uses, the nouns' plurals, the adjectives' endings, the sounds with a meaning (hm, shh, bzz), the places and stars, the Friulian words said to be Friulian and the Slovene words said to be Slovene in every base; the packs' words again where the pack lacks a form, with the pack's meanings; the meanings written, not copied, the forms from paradigms written by hand (docs/plans/05-built/supplement-it.md). Since friuli-projects-a (2026-11-03): the words and forms of the first seven of Friuli's project steps (the table it_cov_40_friuli_projects.txt: abbastanza, il coniglio, reggere, la paratoia, Pinocchio …), written for a child, German first. Since friuli-projects-b (2026-11-03): the words of its six project steps (the table it_cov_30_progetti.txt), each new meaning's prompt its own; the words of Italian's modules and drills and of the Friuli parties (it_cov_50_practice_feste.txt). The file is made whole by it_cov_build.py from the file before supplement-it and every table: no entry lives only here.
